# Nirium

> Payment, audit and execution rails on Stellar for apps, backends and AI agents.
> Non-custodial: your keys, your funds. Not financial advice.

## Network scope
- Stellar mainnet, open: x402 per-request billing, Audit Trail (receipts anchored on IPFS), Reporting.
- Stellar mainnet, invite-only: Payouts, Treasury.
- MPP Charge (Machine Payments Protocol): experimental, verified on testnet, untested on mainnet. For paid access on mainnet, use x402. The MPP client fails on nirium 0.20.0 until @stellar/mpp supports stellar-sdk 17; use nirium@0.19.8 for MPP (checked 23 Nov 2026).
- NiriumVault, Nirium's own contract, stays on testnet until an external audit.

## Packages (versions checked 2026-11-25)
- npm: nirium 0.20.0, nirium-mcp 0.6.13, nirium-cli 3.2.8, nirium-pollar-adapter 0.6.6
- PyPI: nirium 0.13.0

## CLI (nirium-cli)
- `nirium anchor --hash <hex> | --file <path> | --record <json>`: anchor to IPFS via an Audit Trail node; `--sign --key-env <VAR>` adds an ed25519 attestation; `--save <file>` keeps your own copy of the anchored document (3.2.7+).
- `nirium verify <cid>`: checks hash and signature locally; tries several IPFS gateways in order. `--require-signature` (3.2.6+) fails any document without a valid agent signature.
- `nirium cid <file> --expect <cid>`: recomputes a saved receipt's CID locally (3.2.7+); the same bytes re-added to IPFS give back the same CID.
- `nirium report summary` / `nirium report export anchors|payments|payroll`: totals and rows of the whole node, including our own tests, without CIDs (not certified regulatory reporting).
